sn12.24:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn12.24:1.4: atippago kho tāva rājagahe piṇḍāya carituṃ
sn12.24:1.5: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti.
sn12.24:2.1: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi
sn12.24:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputataṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ
sn12.24:3.1: santāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sn12.24:3.2: santi panāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā parakataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sn12.24:3.3: santāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca parakatañca dukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sn12.24:3.4: santi panāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sn12.24:3.5: idha panāvuso sāriputataṃ samaṇo gotamo kiṃvādī kimakkhāyī
sn12.24:3.6: kathaṃ byākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino ceva samaṇassa gotamassa assāma na ca samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyāma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn12.24:4.1: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho āvuso dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā
sn12.24:4.4: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assa na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.24:5.1: tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.24:5.4: asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.24:6.1: tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.24:6.2: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā parakataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.24:6.3: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca parakatañca dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.24:6.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
sn12.24:7.1: assosi kho āyasmā ānando āyasmato sāriputtassa tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
sn12.24:7.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn12.24:7.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako āyasmato sāripattassa tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
sn12.24:8.1: sādhu sādhu ānanda yathātaṃ sāriputto ca sammā byākaramāno byākareyya.
sn12.24:8.2: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho ānanda dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ mayā
sn12.24:8.5: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.24:9.1: tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.24:9.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.24:10.1: tatrānanda yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.24:10.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.24:11.1: ekamidāhaṃ ānanda samayaṃ idheva rājagahe viharāmi veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn12.24:11.2: atha khvāhaṃ ānanda pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
sn12.24:11.4: atippago kho tāva rājagahe piṇḍāya carituṃ
sn12.24:11.5: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti.
sn12.24:12.1: atha khvāhaṃ ānanda yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tehi añña titthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃ
sn12.24:12.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho maṃ ānanda te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ
sn12.24:13.1: santāvuso gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.24:13.2: santi panāvuso gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā parakataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.24:13.3: santāvuso gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca parakatañca dukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.24:13.4: santi panāvuso gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sn12.24:13.5: idha no āyasmā gotamo kiṃvādī kimakkhāyī
sn12.24:13.6: kathaṃ byākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino ceva āyasmato gotamassa assāma na ca āyasmantaṃ gotamaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyāma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.

sn12.24:15.1: tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.

sn12.24:16.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
sn12.24:17.2: yatra hi nāma ekena padena sabbo attho vutto bhavissati
sn12.24:17.3: siyā nu kho bhante esevattho vitthārena vuccamāno gambhīro ceva assa gambhīrāvabhāso cāti.
sn12.24:18.3: jarāmaraṇaṃ āvuso ānanda kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavanti.
sn12.24:18.4: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ
sn12.24:18.5: jarāmaraṇaṃ kho āvuso jātinidānaṃ jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātippabhavanti.
sn12.24:18.6: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.
sn12.24:19.2: jāti panāvuso ānanda kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavāti.
sn12.24:19.3: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ
sn12.24:19.4: jāti kho āvuso bhavanidānā bhavasamudayā bhavajātikā bhavappabhavāti.
sn12.24:19.5: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.
sn12.24:20.2: bhavo panāvuso ānanda kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavoti.
sn12.24:20.3: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ
sn12.24:20.4: bhavo kho āvuso upādānanidāno upādānasamudayo upādānajātiko upādānappabhavoti.
sn12.24:20.5: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.
sn12.24:21.6: phasso panāvuso ānanda kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavoti.
sn12.24:21.7: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ
sn12.24:21.8: phasso kho āvuso saḷāyatananidāno saḷāyatanasamudayo saḷāyatanajātiko saḷāyatanappabhavo
sn12.24:21.9: channaṃ tveva āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho
sn12.24:21.15: jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā nirujjhanti.
sn12.24:21.17: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyanti.
